finding: MonoSwap V3 (L2 watchlist row #18, blast) — zombie-hunt II Phase-2 deep dive
title: MonoSwap V3 (Blast): $112k in canonical UniV3-fork pools is position-owner-scoped; factory owner holds $3.9k (yield+fees); $19.3k USDB yield permanently stranded by claimAllYield bug; E-U $0

category_notes.E-U: $0.00. Max measurable unprivileged extraction across all 61 pools + periphery is $0.000053 USDB (micro-arb minting MUSD via the public deposit() and dumping into USDB/MUSD pool 0x77e149 at the optimal 0.001-USDB size; all larger sizes and all other pools are net losses; below gas). Main USDB/WETH pool ($104k) is priced at market (0.09% vs 0.3% fee) and actively traded (1,204 events/27h). All pools/libraries byte-identical to canonical Uniswap V3; NPM canonical; no stray tokens in NPM/routers/factories; third-party yield claim impossible (USDB/WETH claim() is msg.sender-scoped); no mintable-token drain (KID mint 0.04 ETH/unit vs $0.0049 pool price; BAJA signature-gated; OLE bridge-gated; YIELD controller-gated).
category_notes.H-O: LP principal + swap fees in the 61 CL pools = $112,003.06 (USDB/WETH main pool $104,182; KID/WETH $2,421; WETH/BLSTE $1,697; ezETH/WETH $1,428; WETH/BAJA $1,239; USDB/MUSD $648; WETH/BLAST $579; ...). category_notes.P: Factory-owner EOA 0x90a30F6a76D05Cbe5Dad714838E0b38d53d7f310 (code size 0, live — collects protocol fees): all accrued Blast WETH yield $2,779.82 via claimAllYield (onlyFactoryOwner; fork-proven) + accrued protocol fees $1,076.54 via collectProtocol (onlyFactoryOwner; fork-proven) + ~$31 native gas rebates (0.0124 ETH, gas governor = deploy-time factory owner EOA).
category_notes.S: Accrued Blast USDB yield $19,284.08 (19,375.77 USDB) permanently unclaimable: claimAllYield claims WETH first, then re-reads the now-zero WETH claimable amount and passes it to usdb.claim -> USDB is never claimed by anyone (fork-proven: main pool owner gains 0 USDB while 13,327 USDB stays stranded). Plus $10.22 in 36 zero-liquidity pools (residual balances unreachable) + MUSD contract's 3.72 USDB backing (withdraw() bricked: empty path, mono=0).
